_readme: CognitiveChain mainnet genesis. EVERY node on the network must use a
byte-identical copy of this file: its hash is part of the P2P handshake.
BEFORE LAUNCH replace the three placeholder allocation addresses with real
ones from `cog-node keygen`, and set genesis_time to the launch timestamp
(unix seconds). After the first block is produced the file can never change.
Amounts are in acog; 1 COG = 100000000 acog. Max supply 1000000000 COG:
